patch_list: Stops Adobe, MoEngage, Amplitude, Splunk, Luciq, Branch, and Firebase Analytics. Marketing notifications and in-app promotions from MoEngage stop too. Sign-in, billing, and Tuesdays are left alone. Opt-in; test on-device.
Removes T-Life's ability to get your location while it is closed or in the background. Location while you use the app still works if you allow it. May affect store check-in. Opt-in; test on-device.
Stops T-Life from scanning for Bluetooth devices and beacons, and hides your paired devices. Opt-in; test on-device.
Stops Radar, which sends your location to Radar's servers every 30 seconds while T-Life runs. May affect store check-in and location-based offers.
Stops Quantum Metric, which records what you do in T-Life and is sent your phone number, email, and billing account number.
Turns off the T-Life AI assistant. Support by phone and in stores is not affected. Opt-in; test on-device.

Gives the app a random per-install Android ID instead of your device's, and reports a zeroed advertising ID with ad tracking limited, as if you had deleted your ad ID in Android settings. The video DRM ID is left alone so playback works. O…

Hides nearby Wi-Fi networks and the name of the network you are on from T-Life. Do not enable this if you use Secure Wi-Fi or manage T-Mobile Home Internet in T-Life, since both need to see Wi-Fi networks. Opt-in; test on-device.
